run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T01:14:33Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by frontend-proxy returning HTTP 503 for requests whose downstream path fails at checkout. In Prometheus, frontend-proxy STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate sat at 0.0038-0.0222/s from 01:03 to ~01:23, then rose to 0.1148/s at 01:25, 0.385/s at 01:27 and peaked at 1.126/s at 01:29 (1.041/s at 01:33); the error spans are 'ingress' (http.status_code 503) and 'router frontend egress' (error=true, http.status_code=0). The failure is path-specific: frontend's own error spans are POST /api/checkout, POST, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect, while its cart, ad, product-catalog and recommendation calls stayed at 0 errors. At 01:23:11 the checkout Deployment performed a configuration rollout (revision 1 -> revision 2); the old ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb carried KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092, the new checkout-849d65649b carries KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999, and the kafka Service exposes only 9092/9093, so the new checkout container logs 'dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout', exited once with code 2, is in BackOff, is not Ready, and the checkout Service has only notReadyAddresses - so every checkout request fails and frontend-proxy answers 503. Kafka itself is healthy, flagd fault flags are all off, and the frontend/frontend-proxy pods are healthy; the alerting rule is not loaded in this Prometheus and the declared alert start (01:14:33) precedes the observed error deviation, which remains unresolved.

claims.text: frontend-proxy span error rate (traces_span_metrics_calls_total, status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR) was 0.0038-0.0222/s from 01:03 to 01:23, then 0.1148/s at 01:25, 0.385/s at 01:27, 1.126/s at 01:29, 1.041/s at 01:33 and 0 at 01:37.

The frontend-proxy errors are on span 'ingress' (http.status_code 503) and 'router frontend egress' (error=true, http.status_code=0): at 01:29 both were 0.563/s, and 'router frontend egress' error rate was exactly 0 for every point from 01:02:33 to 01:23:33.

A sampled frontend-proxy error trace shows the same tags and edges: load-generator GET (http.status_code 503, error=true) -> frontend-proxy 'ingress' (503, otel.status_code ERROR) -> child 'router frontend egress' (error="true", http.status_code 0), i.e. no upstream HTTP response recorded on the egress span.

frontend's own error spans are confined to the checkout path: POST /api/checkout, POST, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'tcp.connect' rose from 0 to ~0.5/s by 01:29, while GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, CartService/GetCart, AdService/GetAds, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and RecommendationService/ListRecommendations stayed at 0 throughout.

For span 'POST /api/checkout' on frontend, the STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate was 0.37-0.64/s through 01:23 and 0 from 01:27 onward, while STATUS_CODE_ERROR went 0.096/s at 01:25 to 0.567/s at 01:29 and back to 0 at 01:37 - i.e. the recorded checkout spans switched from unset to error.

A checkout Deployment rollout happened at 01:23:11Z: event 'Scaled up replica set checkout-849d65649b from 0 to 1' and 'Scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0' on Deployment otel-demo/checkout, with the old pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9d9c8 killed at 01:23:14Z.

The old ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (revision 1, created 00:49:53Z, replicas 0) has checkout env KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092, while the new ReplicaSet checkout-849d65649b (revision 2, created 01:23:11Z, replicas 1) has KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999; the live Deployment checkout (revision 2) also specifies KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999.
Service kafka (clusterIP 100.66.162.182, selector opentelemetry.io/name=kafka) exposes only named ports 'plaintext' 9092 and 'controller' 9093; there is no port 9999 on that Service.

checkout pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz logs repeated 'Failed to connect to broker kafka:9999: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout', 'client/metadata no available broker to send metadata request to' and finally 'kafka: client has run out of available brokers to talk to: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout' before re-initializing and listening again on 8080.

The checkout container of checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz has restarted: lastState.terminated has exitCode 2, reason Error, startedAt 01:23:13Z, finishedAt 01:26:49Z, restartCount 1, Ready=False with reason ContainersNotReady since 01:30:17Z, and event 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout' (Warning) was recorded at 01:30:17Z.

The checkout Service has no ready endpoints: its Endpoints subset contains only notReadyAddresses 100.96.4.175 (targetRef pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz) on port 8080, and Deployment checkout reports replicas 1, updated 1, unavailable 1 with no readyReplicas/availableReplicas value returned.

checkout's own span metrics carry no error status: the per-span query for service_name=checkout returned only STATUS_CODE_UNSET series ('HTTP POST', 'orders publish', oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, CartService/GetCart, CartService/EmptyCart, CurrencyService/Convert, PaymentService/Charge, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart) at 0.5-0.65/s before 01:23, all 0 by 01:34.

Checked and healthy: Deployment kafka has readyReplicas 1 and availableReplicas 1 with a ready Endpoints address 100.96.4.148 (pod kafka-ff7884766-ntckh) on ports 9092/9093; Deployment frontend is ready 1/available 1; pods frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-h7j7c, frontend-675fd7b5c5-n4sbv and kafka-ff7884766-ntckh are Running/ready with 0 restarts.

Jaeger trace data available to this Run ends around 01:12: the frontend trace sample covers 01:12:00.5-01:12:00.9 and the frontend-proxy error-trace sample covers 01:03:06-01:10:02, all before the 01:23:11 rollout, and no frontend error-tagged trace was returned for 01:24-01:38.

Kafka is not the failing dependency: Deployment kafka is ready/available with a ready 9092 endpoint, pod kafka-ff7884766-ntckh has 0 restarts, and before 01:23 the previous checkout revision using KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092 published orders ('orders publish' ~0.5/s) with only STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans.

Fault injection through flagd was considered and rejected as the driver: every flag in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) has defaultVariant 'off'.

frontend-proxy or frontend itself being down was considered and rejected: both pods are Running/ready with 0 restarts, and frontend's non-checkout routes (/api/cart, /api/data, /api/products/{productId}, /api/recommendations) kept zero error spans while only /api/checkout errored.

Causal chain supported by the above: Deployment checkout revision 2 (KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999, a port the kafka Service does not expose) makes the checkout container fail to reach Kafka and exit, leaving the checkout Service with no ready endpoints; frontend's PlaceOrder call then fails so /api/checkout returns an error, and frontend-proxy surfaces 503 on its 'ingress' span - which is the error-rate signal behind this alert.

Correct the checkout Kafka address back to the port the kafka Service actually exposes (kafka:9092) in the otel-demo Helm values and roll the Deployment out, then verify Deployment checkout readyReplicas=1, a ready address on Service checkout 8080, frontend POST /api/checkout spans returning to non-error status and the frontend-proxy ingress 503 rate returning to its background level.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting/recording rule is not loaded in this Prometheus target: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no data, so the rule expression, its evaluation window and the source of the reported value 'current: 1.7333333333333332' are unknown; 1.7333 is of the magnitude of the observed 1-minute frontend-proxy error rate (about 1.8-2.7 around 01:24:30-01:29:30, view d3bc98be-713a-4d47-ac53-99381c218aca-t1) but no exact match was verified.

The alert's declared start 2026-11-18T01:14:33Z precedes the first observed deviation of the frontend-proxy span error rate: the 5-minute error rate was 0.0111/s at 01:22 (and 0.0038-0.0222/s from 01:03) and 0.1148/s only at 01:25, and the 1-minute view shows no spike at 01:14:33 (0.0333/s at 01:14:30). No evidence found of an error-rate elevation at the claimed alert start.

Jaeger in this Run has no traces covering the 01:23-01:38 failure window (sampled traces end ~01:12), so per-request error text/status for the failing checkout flows is unknown and client-side impact on load-generator during the incident is unverified; the load-generator 503 spans seen in the sample are from 01:03-01:10, before the rollout.

Who or what applied checkout Deployment revision 2 (Helm upgrade actor, chart/values source) is unknown; the change_history integration is not available, so the exact moment the KAFKA_ADDR value was changed cannot be confirmed beyond the new ReplicaSet creation at 01:23:11Z.

A kubernetes_jq_query for NetworkPolicy objects in otel-demo returned no data; an empty result is not proof of absence, so network-level blocking of port 9999 was not independently verified (the port is also not published by Service kafka).

fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-n4sbv returned 0 lines for 01:10-01:38, so frontend's own error text (for example a gRPC UNAVAILABLE on checkout) could not be read; frontend's failure evidence used here is its span metrics only.

Events in namespace data-recorders during the window (Job Completed/SuccessfulCreate, PVC Provisioning/WaitForFirstConsumer, pod Created/Killing, PersistentVolume VolumeFailedDelete) were not tied to this alert and were not investigated; they are neither classified as impact nor explained.
next_steps: Find the Helm release/value change or commit that set KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999 on otel-demo/checkout around 01:23:11Z, and correct it to kafka:9092.

Locate the RequestErrorRate rule definition in the alerting Prometheus/Alertmanager configuration (it is not loaded in this Prometheus target) to reconcile the 01:14:33 start time and the reported 1.7333 value.
After the fix, confirm checkout Deployment readyReplicas reaches 1, Service checkout regains ready endpoints, and frontend-proxy ingress 503 rate returns to its 0.004-0.02/s background range.
